validator-functions.text: The name equation, fold binding to the processed Insert key, retire and burn bindings, registry-checked mint and burn, and the withdrawal witness path.

offchain-mirror.text: A byte-exact Haskell mirror, the consumer equation, seed-before-policy derivation shared by deployment and attached runners, and evidence verification over accepted records.

deployment-checks.text: Compiled policy compared with manifest and live state, live credential registration with reuse, substituted policies rejected, counts unchanged, and a fresh foreign-registry control.

test-surface.text: Aiken suites with the hash accept, the killed newline mutant, spelling refusals, foreign-registry and missing-witness controls, plus Haskell specs pinning the digest.
